card.text: Large moon that orbits Neptune backward, likely a captured Kuiper Belt object.

introduction.text: Voyager 2 found active geysers on Triton, one of the few geologically active moons.

normal.title: Clear-filter mosaic
normal.summary: Each image is corrected for its viewing geometry before joining; missing and unreliable areas stay empty.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color map
enhanced.summary: Orange, green and blue filters combined; the unlit north stays unavailable.

ultraviolet.title: Ultraviolet-color map
ultraviolet.summary: Orange, blue and ultraviolet filters as red, green and blue; the unlit north stays unavailable.
